body:
Project selection now lives in the shared header, with no duplicate selector in view content. Focus uses the same header above its sections. Mobile utility actions fit in a compact menu with keyboard focus restored after dialogs.

Responsive, Focus, dialogs and editor E2E pass. The running dev application was checked at 320–1440px, including landscape and light/dark appearance. Evidence: progress/2026-09-25-header-project.md. Physical-device and full release acceptance remain open.

metadata.summary: Project selection moved into the shared header
